description: Defines the Footnote class in the MigraDoc library, representing a footnote in a document with methods for adding content, cloning, serialization, and visitor pattern support.

classes.name: Footnote
classes.description: Represents a footnote in a document, providing methods to manipulate footnote content and properties.

classes.name: Footnote.FootnoteValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable property values for the Footnote class, such as Elements, Reference, Style, and Format.

methods.name: Footnote
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new Footnote instance.

methods.name: Footnote(Footnote)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new Footnote with a parent document object.

methods.name: Footnote(string)
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new Footnote with specified text content.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Footnote object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation for the Footnote object.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the footnote.

methods.name: AddParagraph(string)
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph with specified text to the footnote.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.description: Adds a new table to the footnote.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds a new image to the footnote.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an existing Paragraph, Table, or Image to the footnote elements.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Footnote object into DDL format.

methods.name: AcceptVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing the document object model.
